title: Paid newsletter fees
subtitle: Substack vs Patreon vs Ko-fi, with an example month
sections: Patreon: 10% platform fee for new creators + processing.
Ko-fi: 0% on tips; 5% on shop/memberships on the free plan, 0% on Gold ($12/month).
steps: Start a free newsletter (beehiiv or Substack).
Send one useful issue every week.
Ask readers what they'd pay for before switching on paid.
sources: Patreon: standard platform fee for new creators
video: Paid newsletter on Substack: what you keep

tool.name: beehiiv
tool.earns: 50-60% of what they pay for 12 months
